body: Non-blocking (same as verify-story.md): the sim-unavailable fallback calls `just screenshot-sim .workflow/screenshots/feature-verify.png`, but the replaced steps did `mkdir -p .workflow/screenshots` first. `screenshot-sim` does not `mkdir -p` (it runs `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot` directly) and `.workflow/screenshots/` is gitignored, so on a fresh checkout the fallback screenshot write fails with a missing-parent error. Degraded-path only and it exits non-zero rather than passing silently, so no AC impact — but worth noting the parent dir must exist.
